t: Refining AI Collaboration: Notebook Distillation & The Time Traveler's Prompt
s: This article details a method for distilling Jupyter Notebook cells into reusable Python functions using the Pipulate framework, enhanced by the 'time traveler's prompt' technique for guiding AI-generated code and managing data persistence trade-offs in complex workflows.
sub: Notebook cell distillation to Python functions
Time traveler's prompt for AI interaction
Data persistence vs. development velocity in notebooks
